My ABC · Lesson 1

Hello, ABC!

English has 26 letters. Let's read them, say them and write them.

1The alphabet

Every letter has a big letter and a small letter.

Aa
Bb
Cc
Dd
Ee
Ff
Gg
Hh
Ii

Zz
Abig letterasmall letter

2My four lines

We write English on four lines. Every letter sits on the red line.

3Where does each letter go?

Big letters

Start at the top line. Stop at the red line.

Small letters

Start at the middle line. Stop at the red line.

Tall small letters

Start at the top line. Stop at the red line.

Letters with a tail

Start at the middle line. Go down to the bottom line.

4How to write a letter

  1. 1Start at number 1.
  2. Follow the arrow.
  3. 2Then write number 2.

The letters A to Z

Write the big letter, the small letter and then the word.

Aa apple
Bb ball
Cc cat
Dd dog
Ee egg
Ff fish
Speaking · Lesson 1

Good Morning!

Say hello to your teacher.

1Listen and say

Ms. HudaGood morning, Sami!
SamiGood morning, Ms. Huda!
Ms. HudaHow are you today?
SamiI'm fine, thank you. And you?
Ms. HudaI'm very well, thank you. Please sit down.
SamiThank you, Ms. Huda.

2Say it!

Say hello

Hello!
Hi!
Good morning!

How are you?

I'm fine, thank you.
I'm very well.

Say goodbye

Goodbye!
Bye!
See you tomorrow!

Speaking · Lesson 2

What's Your Name?

Say your name and how old you are.

1Listen and say

SamiHello! I'm Sami. What's your name?
LinaHi, Sami! My name is Lina.
SamiNice to meet you, Lina.
LinaNice to meet you, too.
SamiHow old are you?
LinaI'm eight. And you?
SamiI'm seven.
LinaLet's play, Sami!

2Say it!

Your name

What's your name?
— My name is Lina.

Your age

How old are you?
— I'm seven.

Be friendly

Nice to meet you.
— Nice to meet you, too.
